title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
title_zh: 编译消除不确定性：通过程序化编译实现自进化智能体技能

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SkillCompiler , a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs hybrid skill skeletons that retain LLM reasoning for context-dependent operations while compiling well-specified ones into validated programs. To avoid redundant program synthesis and enable executable knowledge to accumulate across evolving skills, we further design a program asset reuse mechanism that organizes validated programs as reusable assets, retrieves existing implementations whenever applicable, and synthesizes and verifies new programs only when necessary. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks and six model families demonstrate that SkillCompiler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 32.33% improvement in task performance.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, tool use, and environment interaction, enabling them to solve increasingly complex tasks, including information retrieval, Web interaction, and interactive problem solving [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . However, agents often need to rediscover similar task-solving procedures when facing new tasks, even when related experience has already been acquired. Agent skills provide a natural way to preserve such experience as reusable procedural knowledge, allowing agents to reuse previously acquired task-solving procedures without updating the underlying language model [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Consequently, effectively accumulating and reusing skills has become an important direction for improving agent capabilities through interaction experience.

paragraphs.en: To continuously accumulate and refine reusable skills from interaction experience, existing work has explored different strategies for skill evolution. Existing approaches can be broadly classified into two categories, i.e., skill content evolution and skill execution augmentation. Specifically, skill content evolution improves reusable procedural knowledge through trajectory distillation [ 9 ] , reflection-based revision [ 12 ] , and validation-guided skill optimization [ 10 ] . Skill execution augmentation enhances how acquired skills are applied by reusing learned workflows [ 17 , 16 ] , incorporating external tool capabilities [ 5 ] , or constructing executable procedural representations [ 20 , 21 , 19 ] . These methods enable agents to progressively improve both the knowledge encoded in skills and the way such knowledge is reused during task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 为了从交互经验中持续积累并精炼可复用技能，现有工作已探索了多种技能演化策略。 现有方法大致可分为两类，即技能内容演化与技能执行增强。 具体而言，技能内容演化通过轨迹蒸馏 [ 9 ]、基于反思的修订 [ 12 ] 以及验证引导的技能优化 [ 10 ] 来改进可复用的程序性知识。 技能执行增强通过复用已学习的工作流 [ 17 , 16 ]、引入外部工具能力 [ 5 ] 或构建可执行的程序化表示 [ 20 , 21 , 19 ]，来改进已获取技能的应用方式。 这些方法使智能体能够逐步改进技能中所编码的知识，以及在任务执行过程中复用此类知识的方式。

paragraphs.en: Although existing skill evolution methods can continuously accumulate and refine reusable task-solving knowledge, they still face two challenges in reliable and efficient skill reuse, i.e., execution uncertainty and repeated capability construction. Specifically, ❶ executing an evolved skill still requires the agent to repeatedly interpret retained knowledge, reconstruct intermediate decisions, and generate corresponding actions through LLM reasoning. As a result, even with an unchanged skill, repeated executions may follow different reasoning paths and produce different outcomes. ❷ Reusable execution capabilities discovered during skill evolution are often constructed for individual skills or tasks and are not persistently organized for subsequent reuse, leading to repeated generation and validation of similar procedures across evolving skills. Therefore, how to reduce execution uncertainty while efficiently accumulating and reusing executable knowledge across skill evolution remains an important problem.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管现有的技能演化方法能够持续积累并完善可复用的任务求解知识，但在可靠且高效的技能复用方面仍面临两个挑战，即执行不确定性和重复的能力构建。 具体而言，❶ 执行一个演化后的技能仍然需要智能体反复解读所保留的知识、重构中间决策，并通过大语言模型推理生成相应的动作。 因此，即使技能保持不变，重复执行也可能遵循不同的推理路径并产生不同的结果。❷ 在技能演化过程中发现的可复用执行能力往往是针对单个技能或任务构建的，并未被持久化地组织起来以供后续复用，导致在演化的各个技能之间重复生成和验证相似的流程。 因此，如何在技能演化过程中降低执行不确定性，同时高效地积累和复用可执行知识，仍然是一个重要问题。

paragraphs.en: Typically, LLM reasoning is inherently probabilistic, which makes the execution of the same skill susceptible to different intermediate decisions and outcomes across repeated runs. In contrast, executable programs encode their inputs, control flow, and state transformations explicitly, so the same operation follows a fixed execution procedure under the same conditions rather than regenerating intermediate decisions at each invocation. Intuitively, when an operation has explicit inputs, well-defined execution logic, and checkable outputs, its execution no longer needs to be repeatedly regenerated through LLM reasoning. Instead, such operations can be realized as executable programs, while LLM reasoning is retained for context-dependent or difficult-to-formalize decisions. Moreover, once these programs are validated, they can be persistently accumulated and reused across evolving skills, avoiding repeated synthesis of the same executable procedures.

paragraphs.en: AI agents can improve subsequent task solving by retaining useful experience from previous interactions without updating model parameters. Reflexion [ 6 ] stores verbal feedback from previous attempts to guide future decisions, while ExpeL [ 7 ] extracts generalizable insights from collections of task experiences. Agent Workflow Memory [ 17 ] induces recurring workflows from trajectories and retrieves them to guide subsequent action generation. Voyager [ 14 ] further accumulates executable skills from successful environment interactions and refines them through execution feedback.
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体可以通过保留先前交互中的有用经验来改进后续任务求解，而无需更新模型参数。 Reflexion [ 6 ] 存储先前尝试中的言语反馈以指导未来决策，而 ExpeL [ 7 ] 则从任务经验集合中提取可泛化的洞见。 Agent Workflow Memory [ 17 ] 从轨迹中归纳出反复出现的工作流，并检索它们以指导后续的动作生成。 Voyager [ 14 ] 进一步从成功的环境交互中积累可执行的技能，并通过执行反馈对其进行改进。

paragraphs.en: Existing work can be classified into skill content evolution and skill execution augmentation . Skill content evolution methods improve the quality and transferability of reusable procedural knowledge by refining skill representations from accumulated interaction experience. For example, Trace2Skill [ 9 ] distills reusable lessons from trajectories. EmbodiSkill [ 12 ] revises skills based on execution evidence. SkillOpt [ 10 ] conducts validation-guided optimization over natural-language skill documents. Skill execution augmentation methods enhance how acquired skills are carried out by introducing additional execution structures or capabilities. For example, Agent Workflow Memory [ 17 ] reuses learned workflows to guide subsequent action generation. FlowEvo [ 16 ] reuses verified workflows as executable skills. AutoTools [ 5 ] augments agent execution with external tools. NSI [ 20 ] , SkillDisCo [ 21 ] , and Agent Skill Induction [ 19 ] construct more directly executable procedural representations from interaction experience.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作可以分为技能内容演化与技能执行增强两类。 技能内容演化方法通过从积累的交互经验中提炼技能表示，来提升可复用程序性知识的质量与可迁移性。 例如，Trace2Skill [ 9 ] 从轨迹中提炼可复用的经验教训。 EmbodiSkill [ 12 ] 基于执行证据修订技能。 SkillOpt [ 10 ] 对自然语言技能文档进行验证引导的优化。 技能执行增强方法通过引入额外的执行结构或能力，来改进已获技能的执行方式。 例如，Agent Workflow Memory [ 17 ] 复用已学习的工作流来指导后续的动作生成。 FlowEvo [ 16 ] 将经过验证的工作流复用为可执行的技能。 AutoTools [ 5 ] 通过外部工具增强智能体的执行。 NSI [ 20 ]、SkillDisCo [ 21 ] 和 Agent Skill Induction [ 19 ] 从交互经验中构建更可直接执行的程序性表示。

paragraphs.en: Different from existing skill evolution methods, SkillCompiler does not merely attach reusable workflows, tools, or executable artifacts to skill execution. Instead, it explicitly analyzes operation-level executability within an evolving skill and selectively determines which operations should remain under LLM reasoning and which should be transformed into validated programs. To the best of our knowledge, SkillCompiler is the first self-evolving skill framework that jointly enables operation-level selective compilation and persistent reuse of the resulting program assets across skill evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 与现有的技能演化方法不同，SkillCompiler 并非仅仅在技能执行时附加可复用的工作流、工具或可执行产物。 相反，它显式分析演化中技能的操作级可执行性，并有选择地判定哪些操作应保留在 LLM 推理之下、哪些应被转化为经验证的程序。 据我们所知，SkillCompiler 是首个自演化技能框架，能够同时实现操作级的选择性编译，并在技能演化过程中持久复用所得的程序资产。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 presents the overall framework of SkillCompiler , which consists of five major components, including the task analyzer, programmer, executor, skill optimizer, and program asset manager. Task analyzer decomposes a task into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs a hybrid skill skeleton. Programmer realizes programmable operations by retrieving existing implementations or synthesizing new programs and validates them before integration. Executor applies the resulting candidate skill by combining programmatic execution with decisions from the target agent. Skill optimizer analyzes successful and failed execution traces to refine the evolving skill. Program asset manager maintains a program asset bank to support program retrieval, updating, and reuse across skill evolution.

paragraphs.en: Phase 1: Executability-aware skill compilation. Given a task, the Task Analyzer decomposes it into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and organizes both programmatic and agent-guided operations into a hybrid skill skeleton. For operations selected for programmatic execution, the Programmer obtains validated implementations and incorporates them into the skeleton to form a candidate skill, while the remaining operations continue to rely on LLM reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段一：可执行性感知的技能编译。 给定一项任务，任务分析器将其分解为细粒度操作，分析这些操作的可执行性，并将程序化操作与智能体引导的操作组织成一个混合技能骨架。 对于被选中进行程序化执行的操作，程序员获取经过验证的实现并将其纳入骨架，形成一个候选技能，而其余操作则继续依赖大语言模型推理。

paragraphs.en: Phase 3: Skill optimization. The executor applies the candidate skill in the target environment and records the resulting execution traces and task feedback. If the skill successfully completes the task, the execution result is returned and the validated skill knowledge is retained for subsequent reuse. Otherwise, the Skill Optimizer analyzes the failed execution trace to identify problematic operations, guidance, or dependencies and generates an updated skill skeleton. Operations affected by the revision are returned to the preceding phases for executability analysis, program retrieval or synthesis, and validation before the updated skill is executed again.

paragraphs.en: A skill may contain operations with different execution requirements. Some operations depend on semantic understanding, contextual judgment, or changing observations, while others follow explicit and repeatable procedures. Executing all operations through LLM reasoning therefore introduces unnecessary execution uncertainty, whereas compiling the entire skill into a program may sacrifice the flexibility required for context-dependent decisions. To address this issue, SkillCompiler analyzes executability at the operation level and selectively transforms suitable operations into executable programs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个技能可以包含具有不同执行要求的操作。 一些操作依赖于语义理解、上下文判断或不断变化的观察结果，而另一些操作则遵循明确且可重复的程序。 因此，通过大语言模型推理执行所有操作会引入不必要的执行不确定性，而将整个技能编译成程序又可能牺牲上下文相关决策所需的灵活性。 为了解决这个问题，SkillCompiler 在操作层面分析可执行性，并有选择地将合适的操作转换为可执行的程序。

paragraphs.en: After operation decomposition, the task analyzer determines whether each operation can be reliably realized through programmatic execution. An operation is considered programmatic when its inputs and outputs can be explicitly represented, its execution procedure can be clearly specified, its preconditions can be observed from the current environment, and its resulting outputs or local effects can be independently verified. In addition, the available tool interfaces should support a bounded implementation of the operation. Operations satisfying these requirements are selected for programmatic execution, while operations involving unresolved inputs, context-dependent decisions, or open-ended semantic reasoning remain agent-guided.
paragraphs.zh: 在操作分解之后，任务分析器判断每个操作是否可以通过程序化执行可靠地实现。 当一个操作的输入和输出可以被显式表示、其执行过程可以被清晰规定、其前置条件可以从当前环境中观察到、并且其产生的输出或局部效果可以被独立验证时，该操作被视为程序化的。 此外，可用的工具接口应支持该操作的有界实现。 满足这些要求的操作被选择进行程序化执行，而涉及未解析输入、依赖上下文的决策或开放式语义推理的操作则保持由智能体引导。

sents.en: After operation decomposition, the task analyzer determines whether each operation can be reliably realized through programmatic execution.
sents.zh: 在操作分解之后，任务分析器判断每个操作是否可以通过程序化执行可靠地实现。

sents.en: An operation is considered programmatic when its inputs and outputs can be explicitly represented, its execution procedure can be clearly specified, its preconditions can be observed from the current environment, and its resulting outputs or local effects can be independently verified.
sents.zh: 当一个操作的输入和输出可以被显式表示、其执行过程可以被清晰规定、其前置条件可以从当前环境中观察到、并且其产生的输出或局部效果可以被独立验证时，该操作被视为程序化的。

sents.en: In addition, the available tool interfaces should support a bounded implementation of the operation.
sents.zh: 此外，可用的工具接口应支持该操作的有界实现。

sents.en: Operations satisfying these requirements are selected for programmatic execution, while operations involving unresolved inputs, context-dependent decisions, or open-ended semantic reasoning remain agent-guided.
sents.zh: 满足这些要求的操作被选择进行程序化执行，而涉及未解析输入、依赖上下文的决策或开放式语义推理的操作则保持由智能体引导。

paragraphs.en: This analysis determines the execution mode of each operation before constructing the skill. In particular, programmatic operations no longer require the target agent to repeatedly generate their internal execution procedures, while agent-guided operations retain LLM reasoning to accommodate dynamic observations and contextual decisions. In this way, SkillCompiler selectively moves well-specified operations from probabilistic reasoning to deterministic execution without restricting the flexibility of the entire skill.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析在构建技能之前确定每个操作的执行模式。 特别地，程序化操作不再需要目标智能体反复生成其内部执行流程，而智能体引导的操作则保留大语言模型推理，以适应动态观察和情境化决策。 通过这种方式，SkillCompiler 选择性地将定义明确的操作从概率推理转移到确定性执行，同时不限制整个技能的灵活性。

paragraphs.en: When task execution fails, the skill optimizer locates the failure by comparing the actual execution of each operation with its operation contract. If an operation produces the expected output and satisfies check i \operatorname{check}_{i} , the operation is retained even when the final task fails. Otherwise, SkillCompiler revises the corresponding component according to the observed failure. An unsatisfied or overly broad invocation condition leads to an update of pre i \operatorname{pre}_{i} . Incorrect information passed between operations leads to changes in argument bindings or dependencies in the skill skeleton. Incomplete execution guidance results in an update of g i g_{i} . paragraphs.en: Table II presents the performance comparison across six language model families in terms of EM on four benchmarks. Taking Kimi-K2.6 as an example, SkillCompiler achieves scores of 85.50%, 74.51%, 96.52%, and 76.00% on SearchQA, OfficeQA, DocVQA, and LiveMath, respectively. Compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, these results correspond to improvements of 1.52%, 16.99%, 0.50%, and 22.00%, respectively. In particular, the most significant improvements are observed on LiveMath and OfficeQA, indicating that SkillCompiler is effective on mathematical reasoning and document-oriented tasks. In contrast, the relatively modest gains on SearchQA and DocVQA suggest that the benefits of programmatic compilation vary across task characteristics. A similar trend is observed across the remaining model families, with the largest performance gains generally occurring on LiveMath. paragraphs.en: To investigate the execution uncertainty, we execute each task three times using fixed learned skills under identical task inputs, initial environment states, and inference settings. We adopt execution instability rate (EIR@3) to measure the proportion of tasks exhibiting both successful and failed executions. For ALFWorld, we further employ average path similarity (APS@3), success-conditioned path similarity (APS succ @3), and exact path repetition (EPR@3) to evaluate execution-path consistency. Table IV presents the results on LiveMath using Gemini-3.8-Flash. SkillCompiler achieves the highest EM of 78.67% and the lowest EIR of 11.00%. Compared with SkillOpt, which achieves the highest EM among the baselines, SkillCompiler improves EM by 14.00% while reducing EIR from 32.00% to 11.00%, corresponding to a relative reduction of 65.6%. Similarly, SkillCompiler achieves the lowest EIR of 3.0% on ALFWorld, outperforming SkillOpt by 4.5%, as shown in Fig. 2 . Regarding execution-path consistency, SkillCompiler achieves APS, APS succ , and EPR scores of 81.3%, 82.5%, and 44.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SkillCompiler effectively reduces execution uncertainty across different task environments while maintaining high task performance.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the resource efficiency of SkillCompiler , we analyze the learning and inference costs in terms of token consumption and model calls. In particular, learning costs include tokens consumed during skill evolution, while inference costs are measured by the average token consumption and model calls per test task. The results are reported in Tables V and VI . Specifically, on LiveMath, SkillCompiler consumes 2.695M learning tokens, reducing the learning cost by 41.9% and 52.1% compared with SkillOpt and GEPA, respectively. Moreover, SkillCompiler requires only 0.450 model calls per task, the lowest among all competing methods. Although its inference token consumption of 13.984k per task exceeds that of SkillOpt, it remains lower than those of EvoSkill, EmbodiSkill, and GEPA. On ALFWorld, SkillCompiler consumes 47.015k inference tokens per task, representing reductions of 7.6% and 32.7% compared with SkillOpt and GEPA, respectively. Meanwhile, its learning cost of 32.442M tokens is also lower than those of both methods. Compared with No Skill, SkillCompiler reduces model calls by 25.7% while improving the task success rate by 18.66%. These results indicate that SkillCompiler achieves substantial performance improvements without necessarily increasing inference costs. Furthermore, Table VII reports the internal execution and program reuse statistics of SkillCompiler on ALFWorld. The PPC reaches 100.00%, while CPO is at least 48.36%. Meanwhile, CSR, PIS, and PAS achieve 54.85%, 88.84%, and 87.06%, respectively. In particular, the high PAS indicates that a substantial proportion of environment actions are performed within program execution spans. These observations provide additional evidence of extensive programmatic execution, complementing the resource efficiency analysis.

paragraphs.en: In this subsection, we assess the contributions of the key components of SkillCompiler through ablation experiments on ALFWorld using DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Specifically, we construct three variants by individually removing the Skill Skeleton, Programmer, and Skill Optimization. paragraphs.en: Limitations. SkillCompiler relies on identifiable operation boundaries, observable preconditions, and independently checkable effects. Consequently, ambiguous or context-dependent decisions remain under LLM control, meaning that compilation reduces rather than eliminates execution uncertainty. Moreover, local validation establishes correctness only under the tested inputs and environment states, without guaranteeing generalization to unseen conditions. The benefits of persistent program reuse also depend on contract compatibility and sufficient reuse to amortize synthesis and validation costs. Finally, our evaluation of SkillCompiler focused primarily on controlled benchmark environments, and its effectiveness across a broader range of tasks and in dynamic web environments remains to be investigated.

paragraphs.en: SkillCompiler integrates operation-level compilation into skill evolution. Its executability-aware strategy combines validated programs and context-dependent reasoning within hybrid Skill Skeletons, while persistent program assets support reuse and trace-driven Optimization. Experiments across five benchmarks and six model families show higher mean task performance. Fixed-bank repetitions on LiveMath and ALFWorld additionally show fewer outcome reversals. Resource savings vary by baseline, while ALFWorld ablations identify the contributions of programmatic execution, explicit operation dependencies, and Optimization.
paragraphs.zh: SkillCompiler 将操作级编译融入技能演化。 其可执行性感知策略在混合 Skill Skeleton 中结合了经过验证的程序与依赖上下文的推理，同时持久化的程序资产支持复用和基于追踪的优化。 在五个基准和六个模型家族上的实验显示了更高的平均任务性能。 在 LiveMath 和 ALFWorld 上的固定库重复实验还显示出更少的结果反转。 资源节省因基线而异，而 ALFWorld 的消融实验识别了程序化执行、显式操作依赖和优化的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Source-grounded checks. A reusable program’s test binding identifies the actual public inputs, source operation, and observed result. Required inputs are checked against the declared schema and linked to public fields or executed-operation arguments. Required outputs are linked to source result fields or independently recorded file effects. Hidden answer fields and task-identity lookup tables are not program inputs. An intermediate computation is not reclassified as a complete answer unless the recorded operation supports that output role. For validation, a separate environment instance is reset to the source task and the relevant action prefix is replayed. The program runs through the permitted interface. The check compares required outputs with the source reference and, where applicable, verifies the native operation and its allowed writes. File checks compare the recorded output effect while retaining the original artifact hash. Parameter variations are applied only when the source supplies a valid independent reference and the varied input satisfies the schema. These tests are evidence of local behavior, not exhaustive branch coverage or semantic equivalence on arbitrary inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于来源的检查。 一个可复用程序的测试绑定标识了实际的公开输入、来源操作以及观测到的结果。 必需的输入会对照声明的模式进行检查，并链接到公开字段或已执行操作的参数。 必需的输出会链接到来源结果字段，或链接到独立记录的文件效果。 隐藏答案字段和任务身份查找表不是程序输入。 除非记录的操作支持该输出角色，否则中间计算不会被重新归类为完整答案。 在验证时，一个独立的环境实例会被重置到来源任务，并回放相关的动作前缀。 程序通过被允许的接口运行。 该检查将必需的输出与来源参考进行比较，并在适用时验证原生操作及其被允许的写入。 文件检查会比较已记录的输出效果，同时保留原始制品的哈希值。 仅当来源提供了有效的独立参考且变化后的输入满足模式时，才会应用参数变化。 这些测试是局部行为的证据，而非对任意输入的穷尽分支覆盖或语义等价性证明。

paragraphs.en: Side effects and failure handling. Isolated validation avoids changing the active task. Task-local execution uses a restorable snapshot where supported, and successful publication occurs only after the associated output checks. A failed attempt retains its actions, model usage, and error record. A restored-away interval is not positive evidence for later skill extraction. Where restoration is unavailable or fails, subsequent decisions depend on actual state observations; the framework does not assume arbitrary external operations are reversible.
paragraphs.zh: 副作用与失败处理。 隔离验证可避免更改当前活动任务。 任务局部执行在受支持的情况下使用可恢复的快照，且只有在相关输出检查通过后才会成功发布。 失败的尝试会保留其操作、模型使用情况与错误记录。 已被恢复操作跳过的区间不构成后续技能提取的正面证据。 当恢复不可用或失败时，后续决策取决于对实际状态的观察；该框架不假定任意外部操作都是可逆的。

paragraphs.en: Asset identity and compatibility. Operations, program realizations, and Skill Skeletons are versioned separately. Operations are consolidated only when they represent the same local capability and have compatible contracts; matching names or input–output types alone is insufficient. Program reuse additionally requires compatibility with the current inputs, preconditions, expected effects, and execution environment. The Program Asset Manager associates each accepted program version with its operation contract, applicable execution conditions, and validation evidence. Changes to the implementation, behavioral contract, or supported execution conditions require validation of the affected realization before admission. A failed realization does not invalidate the operation definition itself. Compatible replacements can serve existing Skill Skeletons if their operation requirements and parameter bindings remain satisfied.

paragraphs.en: Training and trace-based learning. Training trajectories provide evidence for skill induction and revision. The batchwise evolution process described in Section III allows accepted updates to influence subsequent task execution. The Skill Optimizer analyzes both successful and failed episodes to propose local changes and consolidate compatible skills. Retained training trajectories remain associated with the skill state and environmental observations of their original execution when reused for further revision. Task outcomes and local operation outcomes are distinguished. An unsuccessful task may contain independently checked successful operations that support skill learning. Conversely, overall task success does not establish that every intermediate program executed correctly. Failed calls and discarded or rolled-back segments support diagnosis and revision, while only independently checked, retained execution segments provide positive evidence for reusable operations.

paragraphs.en: Resource accounting. Learning tokens include training-trajectory collection, skill construction and revision, feedback, and validation-based selection. Each model request is counted once, and each bank’s learning investment is counted once before averaging across learning runs. Test tokens include input and output tokens from successful and unsuccessful executions, method-internal model calls, and retries. Calls/task counts actual model HTTP requests. Retries contribute to the cost of their original task execution without increasing the number of evaluated tasks. An execution completed entirely by programs contributes zero model requests. The main cost tables average the per-run measurements from seeds 42 42 , 43 43 , and 44 44 . Ablation costs instead average the three repeated evaluations of each condition’s seed-42 bank. These summaries characterize resource use across independently learned banks and during repeated use of a fixed bank, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility and development history. Experimental records associate each run with its model and inference settings, task partition, learning seed, selected bank version, task outcomes, execution traces, and learning and test resource usage.
